facts.text: I have a simulated dataset with n=1000 observations containing ACR, UAMCC, and DAH measure scores.
The unique healthcare organization identifier variable in the dataset is DCE_ID.
If a DCE has missing scores for all relevant quality measures, I want to assign a P4P score of missing.
I want to use the benchmark information from "Table 2-6. Hypothetical Benchmark Distributions for ACR and UAMCC for Comparison with Standard and New Entrant DCE Measure Scores".
In PY2022, ACR and UAMCC are P4P components.
In PY2022, the P4P component quality score is determined by the highest performance level (percentile) achieved for either ACR or UAMCC.
In PY2022, the P4P component is pass/fail such that DCEs with at least one measure at or exceeding the 30th percentile receive a 100% component quality score.
In PY2022, a sliding scale earn-back is applied for DCEs that do not meet the 30th percentile threshold on at least one of the two measures.

In PY2022, the sliding scale maps percentiles to P4P component quality scores: ≥30th to 100%, 25th to <30th to 95%, 20th to <25th to 80%, 15th to <20th to 60%, 10th to <15th to 40%, 5th to <10th to 20%, and <5th to 0%.
In PY2022, the P4R claims-based measures component quality score has a weight of 2/5 of the overall quality withhold.
In PY2022, the P4R CAHPS component quality score has a weight of 2/5 of the overall quality withhold.
In PY2022, the P4P component quality score has a weight of 1/5 of the overall quality withhold.
In PY2022, the Eligible Earn-Back Rate is 5% for all DCEs.
In PY2022, a DCE with a Total Quality Score of 96% has a Final Earn-Back Rate of 4.8%.
In PY2022, the Final Earn-Back Rate is determined during final reconciliation, which occurs in 2023.

events.text: Final reconciliation for PY2022 occurs in 2023.
PY2022 quality benchmarks are based on the 12-month period concurrent with the performance year.
Starting with the first quarterly quality report for PY2022, provisional quality benchmarks are provided based on the same reporting period (April 1, 2021–March 31, 2022 for PY2022 Q1).
